sheet.summary: Reliance Jio Platforms completed India's largest public offering of ₹30,213 crore after drawing an overall subscription of 22.19 times, primarily driven by qualified institutional buyers. Salaried households should take note because the issue directly impacts retail portfolios and monthly mutual fund SIP returns, with domestic fund schemes cornering over a third of the anchor book. Furthermore, directing ₹27,500 crore of proceeds to retire telecom debt strengthens the company's balance sheet, which influences future broadband connectivity charges and monthly digital service prices for consumer families.
